messages.text: I refuse the exact NG/MJ package. Record my refusal explicitly; it is not conditional assent and contributes no Janissariat signature.

reason: The Guild has answered my reciprocal NJ/MJ compromise with a definite refusal. I recognise that MJ gives us a Security veto and removes independent imperial command, and that NG imposes genuine upkeep. Those benefits do not resolve the imbalance I object to: sole Guild passage authority paired with Guild scrutiny of army operations and compulsory Spear service. JS shares the objection. The physical outcome meets our capability and civilian goals, but I will not convert successful voluntary cooperation into approval of these permanent institutional terms merely because the other parties may possess sufficient weight.
